shared_elements: low-relief carving on a large upright stone block/pillar
raised, rounded outline relief against a flat recessed ground
justification: Both are upright stone monuments whose decoration is executed as shallow, rounded, ribbon-like raised outlines standing out from a smoothed ground, and both include sweeping curved bands across the face. The decisive difference is subject and organisation: A is an anthropomorphic figure with a head, arms and a symmetrical arrangement of discs and belts around a body axis, whereas B shows a single naturalistic quadruped in profile set on a plain panel, so there is no correspondence in what occupies which position.
